segments.contextBefore: The ASCII string `"Apple"`. This value is a fixed-length string.
segments.contextAfter: The SHA-256 hash of your merchant ID string literal, which is 32 bytes in size. ![None](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/67dc4b07a8d84366d4cc0e812eb40b4a/spacer.png) You can derive Party V Info from your payment processing certificate in either of two ways. ![None](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/67dc4b07a8d84366d4cc0e812eb40b4a/spacer.png) Method 1: ![None](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/67dc4b07a8d84366d4cc0e812eb40b4a/spacer.png) The UID field of the Common Name includes the plaintext merchant ID. Calculate the SHA-256 hash of that plaintext string. Use the result for Party V Info. ![None](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/67dc4b07a8d84366d4cc0e812eb40b4a/spacer.png) Method 2: ![None](https://docs-assets.developer.apple.com/published/67dc4b07a8d84366d4cc0e812eb40b4a/spacer.png) The OID 1.2.840.113635.100.6.32 includes the hex-encoded hash of the merchant ID . Hexadecimal-decode that hash string to produce the original (non-hex-encoded) 32-byte hash. Use the result for Party V Info.
